assumptions.statement_zh: 总体与重点区使用仓库临时粗略多边形，不是官方红线。
assumptions.statement_en: Overall and key areas use repository rough polygons, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact_zh: 位置与面积只作QA；正式数据到位后整包复算。
assumptions.impact_en: Locations and areas are QA only; regenerate the package when trusted data arrives.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: trusted official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons

assumptions.statement_zh: 公开包没有已批容积率、高度、密度、绿地率、退线等控制。
assumptions.statement_en: Approved FAR, height, density, green ratio and setbacks are absent.

assumptions.statement_zh: 缺少清权的道路、轨道、建筑、权属、树木、水系、设施和行为调查。
assumptions.statement_en: Cleared road, rail, building, title, tree, water, facility and behaviour surveys are absent.
assumptions.impact_zh: 不提出路线、工程、蓝绿或设施缺口结论。
assumptions.impact_en: No route, engineering, blue-green or facility-deficit conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement_zh: 五道口、清华东路西口和北京北站仅按官方公开工程状态列为候选审计环境。
assumptions.statement_en: Wudaokou, Qinghuadongluxikou, and Beijing North Station are candidate audit environments classified only by official public project status.
assumptions.impact_zh: 不提交精确点位/路线，不声称任何候选点已有慢行问题。
assumptions.impact_en: No precise site/route is submitted and no walkability problem is claimed at a candidate.

assumptions.statement_zh: 300—800 米与连续 7—14 天是建议采样框架，不是现场事实或官方标准。
assumptions.statement_en: The 300-800 metre and 7-14 consecutive day values are proposed sampling frames, not site facts or official standards.
assumptions.impact_zh: 需按许可、安全、季节和实际路线调整，并报告样本偏差。
assumptions.impact_en: Adjust for permission, safety, season, and actual route, and report sampling bias.

assumptions.statement_zh: 候选节点可能与已批或在建项目重叠，公开报道不能代替正式工程边界与现场状态。
assumptions.statement_en: Candidate sites may overlap approved or ongoing works; public reports do not replace formal works boundaries or current site status.
assumptions.impact_zh: ACT-001 未通过前不设置二维码、调查点或干预。
assumptions.impact_en: No QR code, observation point, or intervention before ACT-001 passes.

assumptions.statement_zh: 缺少官方文保对象、范围和控制地带。
assumptions.statement_en: Official heritage objects, extents and control zones are absent.
assumptions.impact_zh: 不提出遗产空间或风貌落位。
assumptions.impact_en: No heritage-space or character siting is proposed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 没有清权现状建筑，本稿也不提交设计基底。
assumptions.statement_en: No cleared existing buildings are available and no design footprints are submitted.
assumptions.impact_en: Scale and retain-renovate-demolish decisions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement_zh: 七类群体仅为招募假设，不是人口或需求事实。
assumptions.statement_en: Seven groups are recruitment hypotheses, not population or need findings.
assumptions.impact_zh: 任何需求、优先级和接受度都需研究。
assumptions.impact_en: All needs, priorities and acceptance require research.

assumptions.statement_zh: 行动主体、权限、资金、维护和周期均未确认。
assumptions.statement_en: Actors, authority, funding, maintenance and timing are unconfirmed.
assumptions.impact_zh: 所有行动保持candidate/unknown并受退出门约束。
assumptions.impact_en: All actions remain candidate/unknown and subject to exit gates.

assumptions.statement_zh: 真实绿地和公共空间面积及比例保持未知；空间自检报告的可计算polygon面积为0，只描述当前文件内容。
assumptions.statement_en: Actual green/public-space areas and ratios remain unknown; the zero computable-polygon area reported by spatial review describes the submitted files only.
assumptions.impact_zh: 技术自检结果不得解释为现场值、规划目标或跨方案可比较指标。
assumptions.impact_en: The technical review result must not be treated as an existing condition, planning target, or cross-submission comparable metric.

assumptions.statement_zh: 国际案例只用于机制问题，不证明本地适用。
assumptions.statement_en: International cases inform mechanism questions only and do not prove local applicability.
assumptions.impact_zh: 不得转移指标、主体、位置或政策。
assumptions.impact_en: Do not transfer metrics, actors, sites or policy.

assumptions.statement_en: The English counterpart is an AI-generated equivalent translation.
assumptions.impact_zh: 公开前建议规划与竞赛术语人工复核。
assumptions.impact_en: Human terminology review is recommended before publication.
